notes.title: 0.95 is here with NEW TREES!
notes.content:
Hi, treelovers! We really love your unselfish passion for Nature, so we put some more content in YouAreTre. Enjoy!

New Trees to Play! Finally! And many more to come soon with future new Biom Updates, so stick around!
Added few new random events (all we can say - there's birds in there now ;)
Classic lights/shadows performance improvements

See you all outside! Bye!
